description: Wallpapers, GIFs, videos & animated pixel themes for VS Code and Antigravity IDE — visual picker, instant switching, auto-rotation.
command.setWorkspaceWallpaper: Use Current Wallpaper for This Project
command.uninstall: Remove Runtime and Restore the IDE
config.libraryPath: Folder that holds your wallpapers. Empty = `<Pictures folder>/IDE Wallpapers` (OneDrive is skipped), or `~/IDE Wallpapers`.
config.ffmpegPath: Path to ffmpeg (optional, used to optimize heavy GIFs). Empty = search `PATH`.
config.statusBar: Show the wallpaper button in the status bar.
config.autoRepair: Offer to reinstall the runtime when an IDE update removes the wallpaper.
config.language: Language of the wallpaper picker, messages and status bar. `auto` follows the IDE display language. (Command names always follow the IDE language.)
